create_array_with_zeros: create an array of zeros with a given shape, dtype, and device using the xp namespace
create_array_with_ones: create an array of ones with a given shape, dtype, and device using the xp namespace
create_array_with_empty: create an uninitialized array with a given shape, dtype, and device using the xp namespace
test_unique_all: test the unique_all function that returns values, indices, inverse_indices, and counts as a NamedTuple
test_unique_counts: test the unique_counts function that returns unique values and their counts as a NamedTuple
test_unique_inverse: test the unique_inverse function that returns unique values and their inverse indices as a NamedTuple
test_clip_function: test the clip function that constrains array values to a range with dtype-preserving behavior
test_argsort_function: test the argsort function with descending and stable sort options for array indexing
test_sort_function: test the sort function with descending and stable sort options for array reordering
test_vecdot_function: test the vecdot function that computes vector dot products along a specified axis
test_isdtype_function: test the isdtype function that checks if a dtype matches a specified kind like bool or numeric
test_cumulative_sum: test the cumulative_sum function with optional include_initial prefix for prefix sums
test_matrix_transpose: test the matrix_transpose function that transposes only the last two axes of an array
test_unstack_function: test the unstack function that splits an array into a tuple of 1-D arrays along an axis
test_sign_function: test the sign function that handles complex numbers and propagates NaNs correctly
